title: A Choir for the Portrait
author: Isandro Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Eastwick, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
